Stop with the saved findings. status is the scientific disposition; disposition is
delivery as declared by WriteDeliveryControl.

disposition.description: Write delivery status, not scientific completeness: COMPLETE when no rejected write is left unresolved. Choose disposition PARTIAL to stop with unresolved writes; the host records them in the delivery without marking them repaired.

explanation.description: Your reason for this scientific status.

status.description: Scientific reading status: COMPLETE when the inherited skeleton and saved result together faithfully preserve the complete author-reported execution of the assigned experiments, including their procedural details, relationships and applicable qualifications, with relevant rulings resolved. Unreported details remain unknown. An already adequate account may need no new finding. PARTIAL when relevant scientific meaning remains unorganized, unsaved, unsupported or unresolved in its attribution. Delivery disposition is separate. Saved-item and citation coverage describe this reading's output, not whether a passage was considered or whether the route already has a result. Do not create findings or per-paragraph acknowledgements to clear these lists.
